region_label: Inland — Crystal Springs, Dade City, Lakeland, Ocala
notes: SOURCES: Airbnb (airbnb.com/rooms/*) returned HTTP 403 on every fetch — blocked, snippet-only. Vrbo SEARCH pages returned 403/429, but individual Vrbo LISTING pages (vrbo.com/<id>) fetched fine and gave full room-by-room bed configs. HomeToGo, byowner, floridarentalbyowners, Evolve and RoyalShell all 403'd. Expedia/Travelocity rate-limited (429). The workhorse source was HiChee (hichee.com), a cross-platform aggregator that mirrors Airbnb/Vrbo/Booking listing data including bed configs, acreage and per-platform pricing — its city pages accept ?bedrooms=N&guests=N filters, which is how most of this list was assembled. cozycozy also fetched but with poor data quality. CRYSTAL SPRINGS ITSELF: the named community has essentially NO large-group rental inventory. It is a ~1 sq mi unincorporated hamlet of a few hundred people wrapped around the privately-held Crystal Springs Preserve; the Preserve is a nature/education property that does not do nightly whole-house rentals. Airbnb/Vrbo/HiChee 'Crystal Springs' pages just re-serve Zephyrhills and Dade City inventory. Filtering HiChee to 6+ bedrooms returns exactly TWO properties in Dade City proper (Locke Inn, Luxurious Entertainment Mansion) and ZERO in Zephyrhills at 6BR that aren't actually mis-tagged Wesley Chapel or Dade City homes. Brooksville/Hernando returns ZERO at 6BR. Inverness/Floral City/Citrus County returns ZERO at 6BR (max is a 5BR sleeping 10). So the honest picture is: to stay within ~20 minutes of Crystal Springs you get the Locke Inn or the Dade City mansion, and everything else requires widening to Wesley Chapel (15-25 min SW), Plant City (25 min S), Lithia/Valrico/Thonotosassa (30-45 min S/SW), Lakeland (45 min SE) or Ocala/Marion horse country (1h15 N). POLK LAKE COUNTRY CAVEAT: searching Lakeland/Winter Haven/Auburndale/Lake Wales at 6+ bedrooms overwhelmingly returns Davenport/Kissimmee/Four Corners Disney-resort villas (10-15BR themed-bedroom houses), not genuine Polk lakefront estates — those big lakefront homes on the Winter Haven Chain of Lakes are mostly owner-occupied and not in the short-term rental pool. The one real Lakeland option at this size is a 3-unit compound near Lake Hollingsworth. OCALA/MARION was the richest vein for character at size, as expected — included three. AVAILABILITY: no Dec 19-27 2026 availability was verifiable on any source; Airbnb was blocked entirely and Vrbo/HiChee do not expose a dated calendar to an unauthenticated fetch. Every entry is marked 'unknown' with the reason. All prices are the aggregator's average/typical nightly figure, NOT a Christmas-week quote — expect a holiday premium and a 3-7 night minimum on top.

properties.name: Dade City's Historic 1892 Locke Inn Estate
properties.neighborhood: Downtown Dade City — 37739 Robinson Ave; ~12 min from Crystal Springs
properties.beds_note: not stated — Vrbo listing shows 6 bedrooms / 4 baths but does not publish a room-by-room bed table. Six themed guest rooms; king/queen mix would need to be confirmed with the host.
properties.price_note: Vrbo shows 'Add dates for prices' with no public base rate; cozycozy quoted ~$1,165/night for a sample date, which would put 8 nights near $9,300 before fees. Treat as indicative only.
amenities: walkable to downtown Dade City restaurants and wine bars
ghost tours / murder-mystery experiences on site
properties.why: The single most characterful thing you can rent near Crystal Springs: the 1893 Pasco County Jail, renovated into six themed bedrooms with a full catering kitchen, rented as a whole-property buyout. Walk-out-the-door downtown Dade City, and about 12 minutes from the Crystal Springs Preserve gate.
properties.cons: Sleeps 12 — the low end of your 12-18 range, and the tightest capacity on this list. No pool, no acreage, and it's an in-town building rather than a ranch. Bed configuration is not published, which matters given the king-bed preference. It also functions as an event venue, so confirm you get true exclusive use over Christmas week.
properties.drive_note: ~50 min to Tampa International (TPA); ~1h25 to Clearwater Beach / Honeymoon Island.
properties.availability_note: Vrbo listing page fetched successfully but shows no calendar without a dated search; Vrbo dated search endpoints returned 403/429. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.
properties.phone: not listed on the pages fetched — contact via lockeinn.com

properties.name: Luxurious Entertainment Mansion
properties.neighborhood: Dade City — ~15 min from Crystal Springs
properties.beds_note: listing states 'high-end king or queen mattresses' throughout but gives no per-room count — worth asking the host how many are true kings.
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly across platforms is $491; 8 x $491 = $3,928 before cleaning, fees and any Christmas-week premium.
amenities: outdoor kitchen with professional range and griddle
properties.why: The only Dade City property that actually hits 16 guests, and at ~$491/night it is by far the best price-per-head near the Crystal Springs anchor. 5,000+ sq ft on an acre with a pool and a serious outdoor kitchen — well suited to a multi-gen group cooking together over a week.
properties.cons: 4.6 stars over 18 reviews is good but not spotless. Only 4 bathrooms for 16 people. One acre is a yard, not a ranch — if you want horses and pasture this is not it. King count unconfirmed.
properties.drive_note: ~50 min to TPA; ~1h25 to Clearwater Beach.
properties.availability_note: Underlying Airbnb listing page returned HTTP 403 on fetch; HiChee mirrors the listing but exposes no dated calendar. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Private Estate Oasis With Pond + Land + Jacuzzi
properties.neighborhood: near Epperson Lagoon — ~20 min SW of Crystal Springs
properties.acreage: private acreage with a pond — exact size not stated
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $842 (Airbnb); 8 x $842 = $6,736 before fees and holiday premium.
properties.why: A 7-bedroom modern farmhouse on its own land with a pond and a jacuzzi — the closest thing to the 'space and character' brief within 20 minutes of Crystal Springs, and it comfortably takes 16.
properties.cons: Only 4 baths for 16 guests. Airbnb rating is a soft 4.2 across just 5 reviews — thin review history for a Christmas-week commitment. No pool listed (jacuzzi only). Wesley Chapel is suburban-adjacent, so 'private land' here is modest acreage, not a working ranch.
properties.drive_note: ~40 min to TPA; ~1h15 to Clearwater Beach / Honeymoon Island.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); HiChee shows no dated calendar. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: 7-Bedroom Modern Farmhouse Retreat in Wesley Chapel
properties.neighborhood: near Epperson Lagoon — ~20 min SW of Crystal Springs
properties.acreage: not stated — described as 'peaceful country living'
properties.price_note: no nightly rate published on any of the four platforms HiChee tracks for this listing yet — it is a brand-new listing with zero reviews.

properties.name: GOLF VILLA 6 KING @ Saddlebrook Golf & Country Club
properties.acreage: secluded lot inside the gated Saddlebrook resort
properties.beds_note: listing name is literally 'GOLF VILLA 6 KING' — described as king beds in the bedrooms (several splittable into twin pairs), plus a queen and twins as alternates. The strongest king-bed match found in this whole region.
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $862; 8 x $862 = $6,896 before fees and holiday premium.
properties.why: If king beds in most bedrooms is the deciding factor, this is the listing on this list that explicitly delivers them — six of them. 4.9 stars over 16 reviews, gated resort setting with a putting green, hot tub and cold plunge, and full Saddlebrook golf/tennis facilities on the doorstep.
properties.cons: Sleeps 12 only, so it fails a group of 15-18. It is a resort villa, not a ranch — none of the acreage-and-character the region is otherwise good for. Resort amenity fees and golf/tennis access terms are worth confirming before booking.
properties.drive_note: ~35 min to TPA; ~1h10 to Clearwater Beach.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); HiChee exposes no dated calendar. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Plant City: Pool, Hot Tub & Guest House
properties.neighborhood: farmland east of Plant City — ~30 min S of Crystal Springs
properties.beds_note: Room-by-room from the Vrbo listing: BR1 King; BR2 King; BR3 Queen; BR4 two Queens; BR5 two Queens + 2 twin/full bunks; BR6 (guest house) Full; guest-house living room Full futon; Pack 'n Play available.
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $724 for the same listing (Vrbo itself shows no public base rate); 8 x $724 = $5,792 before fees and holiday premium.
amenities: game room with pool table, foosball and air hockey
parking for 6 vehicles plus RV/trailer space
properties.why: The best-documented listing in the whole region — a full room-by-room bed table, 4 acres of Plant City farmland, pool, hot tub, real game room and a detached guest house that gives grandparents or a couple their own building. Sleeps 20, so 12-18 fits with room to breathe.
properties.cons: Only 2 of the 6 bedrooms are kings; the rest are queens and bunks, so it misses the 'kings in most bedrooms' preference. Four baths for up to 20 people is thin. Strawberry-country flat farmland — pleasant, not dramatic.
properties.drive_note: ~35 min to TPA; ~1h10 to Clearwater Beach.
properties.availability_note: Vrbo listing page fetched successfully with full detail but shows no calendar without a dated search; Vrbo dated search returned 403/429. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Luxury Private Mini Resort (Tuscan Villa on 32 Acres)
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $932; 8 x $932 = $7,456 before fees and holiday premium.
properties.why: Thirty-two private acres under century-old live oaks with a Tuscan-style villa and a resort pool — this is the 'space and character' the inland corridor is supposed to deliver, and it sleeps 18 with 5 baths. 4.7 stars over 16 reviews.
properties.cons: Bed configuration is not published, so the king question is open. Nearly an hour from Crystal Springs — you lose the anchor. At ~$932/night it is one of the pricier options, and 6 bedrooms for 18 people means some doubling up.
properties.drive_note: ~45 min to TPA; ~1h to Apollo Beach, ~1h15 to Gulf beaches at St. Pete.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); HiChee exposes no dated calendar. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $969; 8 x $969 = $7,752 before fees and holiday premium.
properties.why: Eight bedrooms on five private acres with a pool and spa — the most bedrooms available anywhere in the inland-east corridor at a normal (non-Disney-villa) property, and it hits the top of your 6-8BR band exactly.
properties.cons: Only 4 bathrooms across 8 bedrooms, which is a real constraint for 16 people. 4.3 stars over 9 reviews is the weakest rating on this list. Listing says it 'comfortably sleeps up to 14' despite the 16 cap. No bed config published.
properties.drive_note: ~45 min to TPA; ~1h15 to Gulf beaches.

properties.name: Luxury A-Frame: 6BR, 4BA, Pool, Pickleball, Cinema
properties.acreage: 3,834 sq ft house; lot size not stated
properties.beds_note: Stated: king in the primary suite, a second king in another bedroom, two queens (one by a full bath, one in the loft), twin-over-full bunks, plus a modular cinema couch for overflow.
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $784; 8 x $784 = $6,272 before fees and holiday premium.
properties.why: An actual A-frame — the most architecturally distinctive house in the Tampa-inland corridor — with a regulation pickleball court, a 100-inch cinema room and a pool. Two confirmed kings, and it is the closest of the character properties to TPA.
properties.cons: 4.5 stars over 40 reviews — solid but with some misses. Four baths for 16. It's in a Thonotosassa neighborhood rather than on land, so the appeal is the house and the toys, not the setting. 45 min from Crystal Springs.
properties.drive_note: ~25 min to TPA; ~1h to Clearwater Beach.

properties.name: Thonotosassa Villa: Pool, Spa & Game Room
properties.source: Evolve — listed on Airbnb / Vrbo / Booking (via HiChee)
properties.acreage: 4,500 sq ft house on a substantial yard; parking for 8 vehicles plus RV space
properties.beds_note: Room-by-room: BR1 Queen; BR2 King + full sleeper sofa; BR3 Queen + twin/full bunks; BR4-6 Queens. Pack 'n Play available. Only one king.
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $960 (range $960-$1,260+ by platform and season); 8 x $960 = $7,680 before fees and holiday premium.
amenities: huge game room with wet bar
properties.why: Professionally managed by Evolve with 111 reviews at 4.7 — the most proven track record of any 6BR in the corridor. An outdoor projector theater, wet-bar game room and 5 baths make it well set up for a big group over eight nights.
properties.cons: Only one king across six bedrooms — the weakest bed match here. Pool heating is a $75/night add-on, which matters in late December. No events permitted and a 25+ minimum booking age. Suburban lot, not acreage.
properties.drive_note: ~30 min to TPA; ~1h to Clearwater Beach.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); Evolve's own site returned 403. No dated calendar reachable. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Valrico Villa: Pool, Spa, Court & Game Room
properties.source: Evolve — listed on Airbnb / Vrbo / Booking (via HiChee)
properties.acreage: not stated — large yard with tennis court and playground
properties.beds_note: Stated: 1 king; 2 twin/full bunks; 3 queens in one room; 2 queens; 2 queens; a queen floor mattress; full sleeper sofas in the living room and game room; Pack 'n Play. 13 beds total, 24 guests (26 with the floor mattress).
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $761 (range $761-$1,230 across platforms); 8 x $761 = $6,088 before fees and holiday premium.

properties.why: The highest raw capacity of any conventional house here — 24 guests, 13 beds, 5 baths — plus a private tennis court, two fire pits and a genuinely loaded game room. If the group swells past 18 this is the one that absorbs it.
properties.cons: Only one king; the sleeping capacity is built on queens, bunks, sleeper sofas and even a floor mattress, so headline 'sleeps 24' is generous. No events or parties permitted, 25+ booking age, four exterior security cameras. Nearly an hour from Crystal Springs.
properties.drive_note: ~40 min to TPA; ~1h05 to Gulf beaches at St. Pete / Apollo Beach closer.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); Evolve site 403. No dated calendar reachable. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Outdoor Oasis! Group Getaway w/ Pool
properties.source: Evolve — listed on Airbnb / Vrbo / Booking (via HiChee)
properties.acreage: 3,903 sq ft across a main home plus a detached studio
properties.beds_note: not stated per room — listing gives capacity (24, or 26 with a floor mattress) but no king/queen breakdown.
properties.price_note: HiChee range $774-$990/night by platform; 8 x $774 = $6,192 at the low end, before fees and holiday premium.

properties.cons: No published bed configuration, so the king preference is unverified. Four baths for a nominal 24 guests. Brandon is ordinary suburbia — zero of the ranch/acreage character, and ~50 min from Crystal Springs.
properties.drive_note: ~35 min to TPA; ~1h to St. Pete beaches.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); Evolve site 403. No dated calendar reachable. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: The Fairway Estate
properties.neighborhood: across from Temple Terrace Golf Course
properties.beds_note: Stated: primary King; bedrooms 2, 3, 6, 7, 8 Queen; bedrooms 4 and 5 have two Queens each. Bedrooms 1-6 are en-suite; 7-8 sit in an attached guest suite.
properties.price_note: Airbnb average $1,522/night; Whimstay shows $753. 8 x $1,522 = $12,176 at the Airbnb figure, before fees and holiday premium — check Whimstay, the spread is unusually wide.
amenities: screened heated saltwater pool and spa
chef's kitchen with oversized island and double dishwashers
properties.why: Seven bathrooms — six of them en-suite — is the single best bathroom-to-bedroom ratio found anywhere in this region, and for a multi-gen group of 20 over eight nights that is worth a lot. Heated saltwater pool and spa, three laundry sets, chef's kitchen with double dishwashers.
properties.cons: Expensive at the Airbnb rate, and the Airbnb-vs-Whimstay price spread ($1,522 vs $753) needs resolving before you trust either. Only one king across eight bedrooms. It's a suburban Temple Terrace estate — the closest to Tampa on this list and the furthest in spirit from Crystal Springs (~55 min).
properties.drive_note: ~25 min to TPA; ~50 min to Clearwater Beach.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); no dated calendar exposed via HiChee. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Success Avenue Residences — Group Retreat, 3 Private Units
properties.source: iTrip — listed on Airbnb / Vrbo / Booking (via HiChee)
properties.neighborhood: walkable to Lake Hollingsworth, Lake Morton and downtown Lakeland
properties.acreage: in-town; one single-family home plus two private apartments on the property
properties.beds_note: 'Mix of king and queen beds; one bedroom includes a queen and twin setup' — no per-room counts published, but kings are explicitly present.
properties.price_note: Airbnb ~$1,023/night, Booking.com ~$1,186/night; 8 x $1,023 = $8,184 before fees and holiday premium.
amenities: shared outdoor seating and grilling areas
properties.why: The only genuine large-group option in Polk County's lake country that isn't a Disney-corridor theme villa. Three separate units under one booking gives each family unit its own kitchen and front door while sharing outdoor space — often the right shape for a multi-gen week. Walkable to Lake Hollingsworth and downtown Lakeland.
properties.cons: It's a compound of three buildings, not one house, so the group is split across doors — a downside if you want everyone under one roof at Christmas. Quiet residential street with noise restrictions and no parties. 25+ booking age. In-town, not lakefront, despite being in lake country. ~45 min from Crystal Springs.
properties.drive_note: ~50 min to TPA; ~1h30 to Clearwater Beach.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); no dated calendar exposed. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: 67 Acre Retreat on Lake (former Mel Tillis ranch)
properties.neighborhood: Marion County horse country, east of Ocala
properties.beds_note: 18 beds across three buildings — Main House 4 bedrooms / 4 beds (types not specified); Bunk House 12 bunk beds plus a sleep sofa; Lake House a king plus a twin. Crib available. Only one confirmed king.
properties.price_note: HiChee average nightly $608; 8 x $608 = $4,864 before fees and holiday premium. Remarkable value for the footprint.
amenities: private 10-acre lake with two docks and canoes
1,000 sq ft lodge room with fireplace
three BBQ grills plus a Blackstone
properties.why: The standout 'cool accommodation' of the entire search: country legend Mel Tillis's former 67-acre ranch, with a private 10-acre lake, canoes, a sauna, a tennis court, a 150-foot outdoor movie screen and a screened porch that seats 40 — for about $608 a night. Seven bedrooms, seven bathrooms, three buildings, and an on-site caretaker.
properties.cons: The 38-guest capacity leans hard on a 12-bunk bunkhouse, so the sleeping is camp-style rather than king-suite — a poor match for the king-bed preference. It is 1h15-1h30 north of Crystal Springs and about as far from a Gulf beach as this region gets. Events over 50 guests carry a $1,000 fee, so confirm what exclusive use covers.
properties.drive_note: ~1h45 to TPA; no real Gulf beach nearby — Rainbow Springs and Silver Springs are the local swimming, and Daytona Beach is ~1h40 east.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); no dated calendar exposed. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Grand 1920s Estate with Pool, Spa & Gym
properties.neighborhood: Ocala Historic District — ~10 mi from the World Equestrian Center
properties.beds_note: Room-by-room: BR1 King; BR2 Queen; BR3 two Queens; BR4 two twin bunk beds; BR5 a full bunk plus a twin bunk; BR6 (pool house) Queen. One king only.
properties.price_note: HiChee range $676-$938/night across platforms; 8 x $676 = $5,408 at the low end, before fees and holiday premium.
amenities: fully equipped gym with weights and pull-up bar
properties.why: A remodelled 1920s country club in Ocala's Historic District — six bedrooms with six full bathrooms, three kitchens, a gym, a pool house and a hot tub, ten miles from the World Equestrian Center. Real architectural character at a fair price, with a one-to-one bed-to-bath ratio.
properties.cons: Only one king; two of the six bedrooms are bunk rooms, which reads young rather than multi-generational. Ratings are split — 4.7 on Airbnb over 35 reviews but 3.7 on Vrbo over 6, so read the negative reviews carefully. It's 1h15 north of Crystal Springs and nearly two hours from TPA.
properties.drive_note: ~1h45 to TPA; no Gulf beach nearby — Rainbow River and Silver Springs are the local water, Gulf sand is ~1h30 west.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); Expedia mirror returned 429. No dated calendar reachable. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Rainbow River Estate on Blue Run
properties.acreage: 9 acres with 220 feet of Rainbow River frontage
properties.beds_note: Listed as 'king beds' (plural, exact count not given — recorded here as 2), 10 twin beds and a futon. Main house 5BR/5.5BA plus a 2BR/2BA guest cottage.
properties.price_note: Airbnb average $2,430/night; 8 x $2,430 = $19,440 before fees and holiday premium. Easily the most expensive option found.
properties.why: Nine acres and 220 feet of frontage on the Rainbow River — a crystal-clear, 72-degree spring-fed run you can paddle straight from the dock. A perfect 5.0 across 19 reviews, 7 bedrooms with 7.5 baths, and the host's own family home, which usually shows in how it's kept.
properties.cons: At ~$2,430/night it is roughly three times the cost of comparable houses here — $19k+ for the week before fees. The sleeping is king-plus-ten-twins, so it's built for a crowd of kids rather than adult couples. Nearly two hours from Crystal Springs and from TPA.
properties.drive_note: ~1h40 to TPA; ~45 min to Crystal River (manatees, no real sand beach); nearest true Gulf beach ~1h15.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked (403); no dated calendar exposed. Not verifiable for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Chinsegut Hill Retreat and Conference Center
properties.neighborhood: Chinsegut Hill, one of the highest points in central Florida
properties.acreage: historic hilltop estate grounds with hiking trails
properties.beds_note: not stated — cottages are described as 4-bedroom / 4-bathroom lodges with private bedrooms and shared living, dining and kitchenette areas.
properties.price_note: no public nightly rate — this is a retreat centre that quotes per group. Would need a direct enquiry.
amenities: seven 4BR/4BA cottages (56 beds total across the site)
properties.why: FLAGGED AS NON-STANDARD: this is not one 6-8 bedroom house. It is a historic hilltop retreat where you would book two of the seven 4BR/4BA cottages to get 8 bedrooms and 8 private baths for 16 people, with the 1850s manor house and a 65-seat dining hall on the grounds. Included because it is the only large-group option in Hernando County at all — a 6BR filter returns literally zero rentals in Brooksville — and because the setting has genuine character.
properties.cons: Not a private house and not exclusive use unless you buy out the whole site; other groups may be on the property. Cottage interiors are conference-centre plain, kitchenettes rather than a real kitchen, and no pool. Bed types unpublished and almost certainly not kings. Rates require a direct enquiry, and a Christmas-week booking at a conference centre may not even be offered.
properties.drive_note: ~1h to TPA; ~35 min to the small Gulf beaches at Pine Island / Hernando Beach, ~1h to Clearwater.
properties.availability_note: No online booking calendar of any kind — this venue quotes by enquiry. Dec 19-27 2026 would need a phone or email confirmation.
